statement.text:
Does there exist a finitely generated semigroup S with cancellation having
non-exponential growth and such that its group of left quotients G = S −1 S (which
exists) is a group of exponential growth? An affirmative answer would give a positive
solution to Problem 12 in (S. Wagon, The Banach–Tarski Paradox, Cambridge Univ.
Press, 1985).                                                       R. I. Grigorchuk
